query: SELECT json_build_object('source_pages',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.source_pages s JOIN public.books b ON b.id=s.book_id WHERE b.title='Jubayer''s GK' AND s.source_page BETWEEN 279 AND 283),'topics',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.topics t JOIN public.chapters c ON c.id=t.chapter_id JOIN public.books b ON b.id=c.book_id WHERE b.title='Jubayer''s GK' AND c.slug='europe' AND t.slug IN ('bangladesh-constitutional-rights-source-boundary-279','bangladesh-executive-legislature-source-boundary-280','bangladesh-legislature-judiciary-source-boundary-281','bangladesh-elections-services-source-boundary-282','bangladesh-constitutional-provisions-source-boundary-283')),'facts',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_facts WHERE source_page BETWEEN 279 AND 283),'notes',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_notes WHERE source_page BETWEEN 279 AND 283),'mcqs',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_mcqs WHERE source_page BETWEEN 279 AND 283),'mcq_options',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_mcq_options o JOIN public.gk_mcqs m ON m.id=o.mcq_id WHERE m.source_page BETWEEN 279 AND 283),'verifications',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.fact_verifications WHERE source_page BETWEEN 279 AND 283),'flashcards',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.flashcards WHERE source_key LIKE 'batch0279-0283:%'),'search_documents',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.search_documents d JOIN public.gk_facts f ON d.entity_type='fact' AND d.entity_id=f.id WHERE f.source_page BETWEEN 279 AND 283)) AS batch_integrity LIMIT 1;
